lampWall.lw.title: Lamp wall
lampWall.lw.sub: Light a lamp for someone who has passed away. Everyone who sees it can say Ameen to your du'a.
lampWall.lw.empty: No lamps yet. Be the first to light one.
lampWall.lw.signIn: Sign in on Ranks to see the wall and light a lamp.
lampWall.lw.name: Their first name
lampWall.lw.reported: Thank you. We will look at it.
lampWall.lw.reportAsk: Report this lamp? Three reports take it down.
lampWall.lw.removeAsk: Take your lamp down? The Light spent stays spent.
lampWall.lw.note: Light is never money. The lamp carries your du'a and asks others to say Ameen.
lampWall.lw.door: Light a lamp for someone you miss
lampWall.lw.doorSub: A shared wall of du'as for those who passed away
